scope: Real React + CodeMirror in JSDOM; fake-indexeddb exercises the production sketch persistence implementation. No auth provider or simulated session.

checks.name: Root immediately mounts the full IDE and restores an existing local sketch without any account
Static guide remains below the working IDE; one H1, one main and native FAQ interaction preserve editor state
Opening About flushes pending edits in the original IndexedDB database
Optional information pages navigate normally and remain indexable
Public example link requires the local password, then creates a separate sketch without replacing prior work
Reload relocks example opening while saved sketches remain available; cancel creates nothing
Fresh page mount restores all sketches, the active tab and independent edits; compiler assets resolve from root
Returning from help restores the requested homepage title and single guide without duplicating content
All retired account URLs and /ide open the same saved IDE, remove obsolete URL parameters and expose no forms
Unknown example names cannot replace or create sketches
The entire route and editor session requests only the local compiler catalog; no authentication or external requests
